instructions.purpose: Read events from all configured calendars in a bounded range.

tool.name: list-calendar-events
tool.description: Returns full Google-permitted event details and per-source failures.

usage_rules.rule: Always provide explicit RFC 3339 range bounds derived using the configured timezone.
Use this to resolve an exact writable event ID before update or deletion.
Return ambiguous matches to Main and leave them unchanged.
Report failures because returned events may be incomplete.
